title: Reference implementation for Enhancing IoT Security with Metaheuristic-Optimized Explainable AI Models for Intrusion Detection
description: Reference implementation and configuration files for an IoT intrusion-detection workflow with dataset harmonization, partition-first preprocessing, training-only imputation, scaling, feature screening and SMOTE, ResDNN/CNN/RNN models, held-out evaluation, SHAP/LIME explanation, and offline GA/PSO tuning of explainer configurations.
